parts.html: The K-17 standard model is an elegant neoclassical design that combines a calm gray color palette, the expressive geometry of a U-shaped layout, and the functionality of modern kitchen furniture. Solid-color fronts, a compact laminate countertop, and a well-thought-out cabinet arrangement create a harmonious interior in which traditional aesthetics are complemented by contemporary materials.

Gray gives the kitchen a restrained, refined character. The neutral palette makes it easy to pair the furniture with light walls, natural wood, decorative plaster, stone textures, and metal accents. This makes the K-17 model suitable for modern apartments, spacious condos, and private homes.

The kitchen’s defining feature is its U-shaped configuration, which allows the cabinets to be arranged along three sides of the room. This layout provides a convenient arrangement of work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage.
The total length of the kitchen is 6.7 linear meters. The three-sided layout allows the main functional zones to be distributed efficiently and creates comfortable conditions for cooking.

With no separate island, the central part of the kitchen remains open. At the same time, the U-shaped layout provides ample work surface area and plenty of cabinets for storing dishes, food, and kitchen utensils.

In the K-17 model, special attention is paid to the combination of front materials. The upper cabinets are made of laminated chipboard, while the lower ones have a foil-wrapped finish. A single gray color unites the different surfaces into a cohesive composition, preserving the visual harmony characteristic of neoclassical style.

The compact laminate countertop underscores the contemporary interpretation of a classic kitchen interior. The dense, compact structure of the material allows for sleek work surfaces that blend harmoniously with the solid-color fronts.
The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
For convenient storage, the kitchen features a cargo pull-out that makes efficient use of the cabinets’ interior space and provides easy access to food and kitchen essentials.
Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges ensure the doors close smoothly. The drawers run on concealed Muller slides, which round out the kitchen’s functional hardware and support its clean aesthetic.
The model is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included; lift-up mechanisms are not.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-17 standard model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility connections and built-in appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
When developing a custom design, the size of the kitchen cabinets, the placement of work surfaces, and the configuration of the U-shaped layout can be adjusted to suit the specific room.
We offer comprehensive services covering kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
You can order the K-17 kitchen or get a personalized price quote from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
